question: Who among the following gives a speech on Republic Day at Rajpath?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The President of India.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The President of India gives a speech on Republic Day at Rajpath.**
 
• The President of India is the head of state of India and is elected by the Electoral College consisting of elected members of both houses of Parliament and of the Legislative Assemblies of
